findings.description: to-tickets step 5 still writes `pup plan add "<goal>" --scope <glob>... --accept "<criterion>"`, which is the double-quoted form with an unquoted glob that triage line 48 now forbids. Design-note criteria use backticks for code (see AGENT-BRIEF.md), so bash runs those spans as commands and stores a mangled criterion. Single-quote every argument, as triage does.

process_issues.description: I skipped correctness, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety, maintainability and spec. The PR is markdown skill prose only: no code logic, no workflow change, no closing issue. I also skipped the consolidator, because only one finding came back and there was nothing to deduplicate.

I gave the reviewers PR-copy paths of the form `.claude-pr/skills/...`. The preserved copies are actually at `.claude-pr/.claude/skills/...`. The reviewers found the real path or read the files with `git show`, so coverage was not lost.

The security reviewer tagged the to-tickets quoting finding important. I retagged it pre-existing during the provenance check: line 59 is not among the lines the diff adds, and to-tickets was already reading issue comments into that command before this PR.
